Research report b00327: Eric Marshall White's 2017 census, called the best current reference by Rangel & Alabert (2022), counts 20 complete copies, 4 on vellum (Library of Congress, Göttingen, BnF, British Library) and 16 on paper, as does the Harry Ransom Center; 21 is an older census tradition and 25 an outdated table that counts copies missing leaves (Huntington's vellum copy lacks two). 49 survivors = 48 reasonably intact (36 paper, 12 vellum) + the dispersed Noble Fragments; 158 or 180 are Piccolomini's two contemporary figures, and modern estimates (120–135 paper, 40–45 vellum) give about 160–180, not 160–185.
